architecture.en: The city's architecture reflects the influence of several different cultures.
architecture.zh: 这座城市的建筑风格反映了几种不同文化的影响。

architect.en: The architect designed the museum to make the best use of natural light.
architect.zh: 建筑师在设计博物馆时充分利用了自然光。

architectural.en: The old railway station is one of the town's finest architectural treasures.
architectural.zh: 这座老火车站是镇上最精美的建筑瑰宝之一。

structure.en: The structure of the building allows it to move during an earthquake.
structure.zh: 这座建筑的结构使它能在地震时摆动。

foundation.en: Soft ground meant that the foundation of the tower had to be very deep.
foundation.zh: 地面松软,所以塔的地基必须打得很深。

foundation.en: A charitable foundation paid for the restoration of the old library.
foundation.zh: 一家慈善基金会出资修复了这座旧图书馆。

pillar.en: Huge stone pillars support the roof of the ancient temple.
pillar.zh: 巨大的石柱支撑着古庙的屋顶。

column.en: The front of the building is decorated with tall marble columns.
column.zh: 建筑正面装饰着高大的大理石圆柱。

column.en: Her weekly newspaper column discusses issues in modern education.
column.zh: 她每周的报纸专栏讨论现代教育问题。

beam.en: Heavy wooden beams hold up the roof of the old market hall.
beam.zh: 沉重的木横梁支撑着老市场大厅的屋顶。

arch.en: The Romans used the arch to build long bridges and large buildings.
arch.zh: 罗马人利用拱修建长桥和大型建筑。

dome.en: The great dome of the cathedral took more than sixteen years to build.
dome.zh: 大教堂的巨大穹顶花了十六年多才建成。

facade.en: The historic facade was kept when the rest of the building was replaced.
facade.zh: 建筑其余部分被更换时,这面历史悠久的建筑正面保留了下来。

skyscraper.en: The development of the steel frame made the first skyscraper possible.
skyscraper.zh: 钢框架的发展使第一座摩天大楼成为可能。

high-rise.en: High-rise flats were built quickly to replace homes destroyed in the war.
high-rise.zh: 人们迅速建起高层公寓,以取代在战争中被毁的房屋。

storey.en: The new office building will be twenty storeys high.
storey.zh: 新办公楼将有二十层高。

concrete.en: Concrete is now the most widely used building material in the world.
concrete.zh: 混凝土现在是世界上使用最广泛的建筑材料。

concrete.en: The study offers few concrete suggestions for solving the problem.
concrete.zh: 这项研究几乎没有提出解决问题的具体建议。

steel.en: The use of steel allowed engineers to build much longer bridges.
steel.zh: 钢材的使用使工程师能够建造更长的桥梁。

material.en: Bamboo is a popular building material in many parts of Asia.
material.zh: 竹子在亚洲许多地区都是很受欢迎的建筑材料。

blueprint.en: The engineer's original blueprint for the bridge is kept in the city museum.
blueprint.zh: 工程师最初的桥梁蓝图保存在市博物馆。

engineer.en: The engineer who designed the tunnel was just twenty-six years old.
engineer.zh: 设计这条隧道的工程师年仅二十六岁。

infrastructure.en: Poor infrastructure is holding back economic growth in rural areas.
infrastructure.zh: 基础设施落后阻碍了农村地区的经济增长。

urban.en: More than half of the world's population now lives in urban areas.
urban.zh: 世界上一半以上的人口现在居住在城市地区。

rural.en: Young people are leaving rural areas to look for work in the cities.
rural.zh: 年轻人正在离开农村地区,去城市找工作。

suburban.en: Suburban families tend to rely on private cars for almost every journey.
suburban.zh: 郊区家庭几乎每次出行都依赖私家车。

metropolis.en: The small port grew into a huge metropolis within a hundred years.
metropolis.zh: 这个小港口在一百年内发展成了一座大都市。

urbanisation.en: Rapid urbanisation has put heavy pressure on housing and water supplies.
urbanisation.zh: 快速城市化给住房和供水带来了沉重压力。

urban-sprawl.en: Urban sprawl has replaced large areas of farmland with low-density housing.
urban-sprawl.zh: 城市扩张使大片农田变成了低密度住宅区。

population-density.en: Tokyo has a very high population density compared with most other cities.
population-density.zh: 与大多数其他城市相比,东京的人口密度非常高。

congestion.en: A charge for driving in the city centre has reduced traffic congestion.
congestion.zh: 市中心行车收费减少了交通拥堵。

slum.en: Millions of people in the region live in a slum without clean water.
slum.zh: 该地区有数百万人住在没有清洁用水的贫民窟。

housing.en: The shortage of cheap housing is a serious problem for young workers.
housing.zh: 廉价住房短缺对年轻工人来说是个严重问题。

residential.en: The new road will run through a quiet residential part of the city.
residential.zh: 新路将穿过城市一处安静的住宅区。

commercial.en: The old warehouses have been turned into commercial and office space.
commercial.zh: 这些旧仓库被改造成了商业和办公空间。

industrial.en: Many industrial cities declined when the factories closed down.
industrial.zh: 工厂关闭后,许多工业城市衰落了。

zone.en: Cars are not allowed in the pedestrian zone at the centre of town.
zone.zh: 市中心的步行区不允许汽车通行。

district.en: The old financial district is now full of shops and restaurants.
district.zh: 老金融区现在到处是商店和餐馆。

municipal.en: Municipal authorities are responsible for collecting rubbish and repairing local roads.
municipal.zh: 市政当局负责收集垃圾和维修当地道路。

council.en: The city council voted to create more bicycle lanes in the centre.
council.zh: 市议会投票决定在市中心增设更多自行车道。

planning-permission.en: The company needs planning permission before it can build on the land.
planning-permission.zh: 公司要在这块土地上建房,必须先获得规划许可。

green-belt.en: Building is strictly limited on the green belt around the city.
green-belt.zh: 城市周围的绿化带严格限制建房。

public-space.en: Good public space encourages people to spend more time outdoors.
public-space.zh: 良好的公共空间鼓励人们更多地待在户外。

heritage-building.en: Developers are not allowed to change the outside of a heritage building.
heritage-building.zh: 开发商不得改变历史建筑的外观。

restoration.en: The restoration of the old theatre cost more than ten million pounds.
restoration.zh: 这座老剧院的修复花费超过一千万英镑。

sewage.en: Untreated sewage can pollute drinking water and spread serious diseases.
sewage.zh: 未经处理的污水会污染饮用水,传播严重疾病。

drainage.en: Poor drainage caused the streets to flood after heavy rain.
drainage.zh: 排水系统不畅导致街道在大雨后被淹。

ventilation.en: Good ventilation is essential in buildings with a large number of people.
ventilation.zh: 在人员众多的建筑里,良好的通风至关重要。

eaves.en: Birds often build their nests under the eaves of old houses.
eaves.zh: 鸟常常在老房子的屋檐下筑巢。

thatch.en: Cottages with a roof of thatch are common in this part of England.
thatch.zh: 茅草屋顶的小屋在英格兰这一地区很常见。

clay.en: Bricks are made by baking clay at very high temperatures.
clay.zh: 砖是把黏土在高温下烧制而成的。

asphalt.en: Dark asphalt roads absorb heat and make cities warmer in summer.
asphalt.zh: 深色的沥青路面吸收热量,使城市夏天更热。

shelter.en: The caves provided shelter for early people during the coldest months.
shelter.zh: 这些洞穴在最冷的几个月为早期人类提供了庇护。

shelter.en: Trees planted along the coast shelter the town from strong winds.
shelter.zh: 沿海种植的树木为小镇挡住了强风。

cityscape.en: Tall glass buildings have transformed the cityscape over the past twenty years.
cityscape.zh: 过去二十年,高大的玻璃建筑改变了城市景观。

metropolitan.en: The metropolitan area now has a population of nearly ten million.
metropolitan.zh: 这一大都市地区现在的人口接近一千万。

municipality.en: Each municipality is responsible for running its own schools.
municipality.zh: 每个自治市负责管理自己的学校。

county.en: The county is known for its farming and its old market towns.
county.zh: 这个郡以农业和古老的集镇闻名。

provincial.en: Provincial governments have been given more control over health spending.
provincial.zh: 省级政府获得了对医疗支出更大的控制权。

rustic.en: The hotel has a rustic charm, with stone walls and wooden furniture.
rustic.zh: 这家酒店有一种乡村韵味,石墙配木制家具。

inhabitant.en: The island's first inhabitants arrived by boat about three thousand years ago.
inhabitant.zh: 这座岛最早的居民大约三千年前乘船来到这里。

resident.en: Local residents have complained about noise from the new airport.
resident.zh: 当地居民投诉新机场的噪音。

demography.en: Changes in demography will affect the demand for schools and hospitals.
demography.zh: 人口结构的变化将影响对学校和医院的需求。

bottleneck.en: The narrow bridge has become a serious bottleneck for traffic entering the city.
bottleneck.zh: 这座窄桥已成为进城交通的严重瓶颈。

residential-area.en: The new train line will connect the main residential area with the city centre.
residential-area.zh: 新铁路线将把主要住宅区与市中心连接起来。

central-business-district.en: Office rents are highest in the central business district of the city.
central-business-district.zh: 城市中央商务区的办公室租金最高。

real-estate.en: Foreign investors have been buying real estate in the capital.
real-estate.zh: 外国投资者一直在首都购买房地产。

block-of-flats.en: The block of flats was built in the 1960s to house factory workers.
block-of-flats.zh: 这栋公寓楼建于 20 世纪 60 年代,供工厂工人居住。

planner.en: Every planner must think about the long-term effects of new roads.
planner.zh: 每位规划者都必须考虑新道路的长期影响。

slab.en: A huge stone slab covered the entrance to the ancient tomb.
slab.zh: 一块巨大的石板盖住了古墓的入口。

partition.en: Thin partitions divide the large office into smaller working areas.
partition.zh: 薄隔断把大办公室分成了较小的工作区。

interior.en: The interior of the building has been completely modernised.
interior.zh: 建筑内部已经完全现代化了。

chamber.en: The king's burial chamber was discovered beneath the floor of the hall.
chamber.zh: 国王的墓室是在大厅地板下发现的。

erect.en: Workers erected the entire tower in less than two years.
erect.zh: 工人们用不到两年时间建成了整座塔。

enclosure.en: The animals are kept in a large enclosure at the edge of the park.
enclosure.zh: 这些动物被养在公园边缘的一个大围场里。

shaft.en: Miners went down a deep shaft to reach the coal below.
shaft.zh: 矿工们下到深深的竖井中采煤。

locality.en: Each locality has its own traditions and style of cooking.
locality.zh: 每个地区都有自己的传统和烹饪风格。

perimeter.en: A high wall runs around the entire perimeter of the old city.
perimeter.zh: 一道高墙环绕着老城的整个周边。

vehicle.en: Every vehicle entering the city centre must now pay a daily charge.
vehicle.zh: 现在每辆进入市中心的车辆都要付每日费用。

automobile.en: The invention of the automobile changed the shape of modern cities.
automobile.zh: 汽车的发明改变了现代城市的形态。

engine.en: The steam engine made it possible to power factories without water.
engine.zh: 蒸汽机使工厂不用水力也能运转。

motor.en: The small electric motor turns the wheels at a constant speed.
motor.zh: 这台小型电动马达以恒定的速度驱动车轮。

fuel.en: Ships use huge quantities of fuel on their long voyages.
fuel.zh: 船舶在远航中消耗大量燃料。

petrol.en: The price of petrol has a direct effect on the cost of transport.
petrol.zh: 汽油价格直接影响运输成本。

diesel.en: Many cities plan to ban diesel cars in order to improve air quality.
diesel.zh: 许多城市计划禁止柴油车,以改善空气质量。

electric-vehicle.en: An electric vehicle produces no exhaust fumes while it is being driven.
electric-vehicle.zh: 电动汽车行驶时不产生尾气。

hybrid.en: A hybrid uses both a petrol engine and an electric motor.
hybrid.zh: 混合动力汽车同时使用汽油发动机和电动马达。

railway.en: The railway brought rapid economic growth to the towns along its route.
railway.zh: 铁路给沿线城镇带来了快速的经济增长。

locomotive.en: The first steam locomotive could pull only a few small wagons.
locomotive.zh: 第一台蒸汽机车只能拉几节小车厢。

high-speed-rail.en: High-speed rail has greatly reduced journey times between the major cities.
high-speed-rail.zh: 高铁大大缩短了主要城市之间的行程时间。

aviation.en: Early aviation was very dangerous, and many pilots lost their lives.
aviation.zh: 早期航空非常危险,许多飞行员丧生。

aircraft.en: New aircraft use far less fuel than those built thirty years ago.
aircraft.zh: 新飞机比三十年前制造的飞机省油得多。

runway.en: A second runway would allow the airport to handle many more flights.
runway.zh: 第二条跑道将使机场能够处理更多航班。

navigation.en: Satellites have made navigation far easier for ships and aircraft.
navigation.zh: 卫星使船舶和飞机的导航容易多了。

canal.en: Goods were carried along the canal from the coast to the factories.
canal.zh: 货物沿运河从海岸运到工厂。

tunnel.en: The new tunnel under the river will take five years to complete.
tunnel.zh: 河底的新隧道需要五年才能建成。

dam.en: The dam provides electricity for millions of people but has damaged river life.
dam.zh: 这座水坝为数百万人供电,却破坏了河流生态。

highway.en: A new highway has reduced the journey between the two cities by an hour.
highway.zh: 一条新公路使两座城市之间的路程缩短了一小时。

freight.en: More freight is now carried by road than by rail in most countries.
freight.zh: 在大多数国家,现在公路货运量超过铁路。

cargo.en: The ship was carrying a cargo of grain when it sank.
cargo.zh: 这艘船沉没时正运载着一批谷物。

logistics.en: Online shopping has created new challenges for logistics companies.
logistics.zh: 网购给物流公司带来了新的挑战。

public-transport.en: Cheap public transport can reduce the number of cars on the road.
public-transport.zh: 便宜的公共交通可以减少路上的汽车数量。

commuter.en: The average commuter spends more than an hour a day travelling to work.
commuter.zh: 普通通勤者每天上班路上要花一个多小时。

traffic-jam.en: Each traffic jam costs the economy a great deal in lost working time.
traffic-jam.zh: 每次交通堵塞都因工作时间损失给经济带来巨大代价。

rush-hour.en: Buses are often overcrowded during the morning rush hour.
rush-hour.zh: 早高峰期间,公交车经常超载。

collision.en: A collision between two ships closed the port for several days.
collision.zh: 两艘船相撞导致港口关闭数日。

speed-limit.en: Lowering the speed limit has reduced serious accidents near schools.
speed-limit.zh: 降低限速减少了学校附近的严重事故。

driverless-car.en: A driverless car uses sensors and cameras to follow the road.
driverless-car.zh: 无人驾驶汽车利用传感器和摄像头沿道路行驶。

mechanical.en: Mechanical clocks were first built in European churches in the Middle Ages.
mechanical.zh: 机械钟最早是中世纪在欧洲教堂建造的。

device.en: The small device measures the level of oxygen in the blood.
device.zh: 这个小装置测量血液中的氧含量。

apparatus.en: The scientist built a simple apparatus to test his idea about air.
apparatus.zh: 这位科学家制作了一个简单的器械来检验他关于空气的想法。

gear.en: A bicycle's gears make it easier to ride up steep hills.
gear.zh: 自行车的齿轮使骑车上陡坡更容易。

axle.en: The wheels turn on a metal axle fixed underneath the cart.
axle.zh: 车轮绕着固定在车下的金属车轴转动。

lever.en: A long lever allows a person to lift a very heavy stone.
lever.zh: 长杠杆让人能抬起很重的石头。

pulley.en: With a pulley, workers could raise heavy stones to the top of the wall.
pulley.zh: 利用滑轮,工人能把沉重的石头吊到墙顶。

propeller.en: The ship's large propeller is driven by a powerful diesel engine.
propeller.zh: 这艘船的大螺旋桨由强力柴油发动机驱动。

prototype.en: Engineers tested the prototype for several months before starting production.
prototype.zh: 工程师对原型测试了几个月才开始生产。

patent.en: The inventor applied for a patent to protect his new design.
patent.zh: 这位发明家申请了专利,以保护他的新设计。

invention.en: The invention of the telephone transformed the way people communicate.
invention.zh: 电话的发明彻底改变了人们的交流方式。

inventor.en: The inventor of the machine died before he could see its success.
inventor.zh: 这台机器的发明者没能看到它的成功就去世了。

accelerate.en: Rising temperatures may accelerate the melting of the polar ice.
accelerate.zh: 气温上升可能加速极地冰层的融化。

decelerate.en: Economic growth began to decelerate towards the end of the decade.
decelerate.zh: 到这十年的末期,经济增长开始放缓。

brake.en: The driver's foot pressed the brake just before the collision.
brake.zh: 就在相撞之前,司机踩下了刹车。

skid.en: Cars may skid on wet roads if their tyres are worn.
skid.zh: 如果轮胎磨损,汽车在湿滑路面上可能打滑。

traction.en: Wide tyres give the vehicle better traction on soft sand.
traction.zh: 宽轮胎让车辆在软沙上有更好的牵引力。

suspension.en: A good suspension system makes the ride more comfortable on rough roads.
suspension.zh: 良好的悬架系统使车辆在崎岖路面上行驶更舒适。

suspension.en: The suspension of the train service caused long delays for commuters.
suspension.zh: 火车停运给通勤者造成了长时间延误。

windscreen.en: Laminated glass prevents the windscreen from breaking into sharp pieces.
windscreen.zh: 夹层玻璃防止挡风玻璃碎成锋利的碎片。

guardrail.en: The car hit the guardrail but did not fall from the bridge.
guardrail.zh: 汽车撞上了护栏,但没有从桥上掉下去。

helicopter.en: A helicopter was used to rescue people from the flooded village.
helicopter.zh: 人们用直升机营救被洪水围困的村民。

cyclist.en: Each cyclist in the city benefits from the new network of separate lanes.
cyclist.zh: 城里的每位骑车人都受益于新的独立车道网络。

machinery.en: New farm machinery reduced the number of workers needed on the land.
machinery.zh: 新的农业机器减少了田间所需的工人数量。

carrier.en: Low-cost carriers have made air travel affordable for many more people.
carrier.zh: 低成本运输公司让更多人负担得起航空旅行。

carrier.en: A person can be a carrier of the disease without showing any symptoms.
carrier.zh: 一个人可能是这种疾病的携带者而没有任何症状。

container.en: The use of the shipping container greatly reduced the cost of transporting goods.
container.zh: 集装箱的使用大大降低了货物运输成本。

radar.en: Radar was developed to detect enemy aircraft during the war.
radar.zh: 雷达是在战争期间为探测敌机而研制的。

valve.en: The valve controls how much steam enters the engine.
valve.zh: 阀门控制进入发动机的蒸汽量。

cable.en: A cable under the Atlantic first linked Europe and America by telegraph.
cable.zh: 大西洋海底的电缆首次用电报连接了欧洲和美洲。

bolt.en: Each steel bolt in the bridge is checked regularly for signs of weakness.
bolt.zh: 桥上的每个钢螺栓都定期检查是否有松动迹象。

anchor.en: The ship dropped its anchor in the shelter of the bay.
anchor.zh: 船在海湾的避风处抛了锚。

screw.en: A tiny loose screw caused the entire machine to stop working.
screw.zh: 一颗松动的小螺丝导致整台机器停止工作。

coil.en: An electric current passing through a coil of wire creates a magnetic field.
coil.zh: 电流通过线圈时产生磁场。

crash.en: The plane crash led to important changes in airline safety rules.
crash.zh: 这次飞机坠毁促使航空安全规则作出重要修改。

crash.en: Share prices crashed in 1929, and many investors lost everything.
crash.zh: 1929 年股价暴跌,许多投资者倾家荡产。

collide.en: Birds sometimes collide with tall glass buildings during migration.
collide.zh: 鸟类在迁徙时有时会撞上高大的玻璃建筑。

economy.en: The local economy depends heavily on fishing and tourism.
economy.zh: 当地经济严重依赖渔业和旅游业。

economic.en: The country enjoyed a long period of economic growth after the war.
economic.zh: 战后,这个国家经历了长时期的经济增长。

economical.en: Smaller cars are more economical and produce less pollution.
economical.zh: 小型车更省油,污染也更少。

economist.en: One economist argues that higher wages would actually create more jobs.
economist.zh: 一位经济学家认为,提高工资实际上会创造更多就业机会。

finance.en: London became a world centre of finance during the nineteenth century.
finance.zh: 十九世纪,伦敦成为世界金融中心。

financial.en: Many small businesses are facing serious financial difficulties this year.
financial.zh: 今年许多小企业面临严重的财务困难。

capital.en: The company needed more capital to develop its new product.
capital.zh: 公司需要更多资本来开发新产品。

capital.en: Canberra was chosen as the capital of Australia in 1908.
capital.zh: 1908 年,堪培拉被选为澳大利亚的首都。

investment.en: Foreign investment has helped to create jobs in the region.
investment.zh: 外国投资帮助该地区创造了就业机会。

investor.en: A wise investor spreads risk across several different types of business.
investor.zh: 明智的投资者把风险分散到几种不同类型的企业。

asset.en: The company's main asset is its well-known brand name.
asset.zh: 公司的主要资产是它的知名品牌。

liability.en: The firm's liabilities were much greater than the value of its property.
liability.zh: 这家公司的负债远高于其财产的价值。

revenue.en: Tourism is an important source of revenue for the national government.
revenue.zh: 旅游业是中央政府重要的收入来源。

income.en: Average income has risen, but so has the cost of housing.
income.zh: 平均收入有所上升,但住房成本也上升了。

profit.en: The company made a large profit from selling its products overseas.
profit.zh: 这家公司在海外销售产品获得了巨额利润。

loss.en: The airline reported a heavy loss for the third year in a row.
loss.zh: 这家航空公司连续第三年报告巨额亏损。

turnover.en: The small firm had a turnover of two million pounds last year.
turnover.zh: 这家小公司去年的营业额为两百万英镑。

turnover.en: Low pay has led to a high turnover of staff in the industry.
turnover.zh: 低工资导致这个行业的人员流动率很高。

cost.en: The cost of solar power has fallen sharply in the last decade.
cost.zh: 过去十年,太阳能的成本急剧下降。

expense.en: The expense of maintaining old buildings is a problem for many towns.
expense.zh: 维护老建筑的费用是许多城镇面临的问题。

inflation.en: High inflation reduces the value of people's savings.
inflation.zh: 高通货膨胀会降低人们储蓄的价值。

deflation.en: During a period of deflation, consumers often delay buying expensive goods.
deflation.zh: 在通货紧缩时期,消费者常常推迟购买昂贵商品。

recession.en: Thousands of companies closed during the recession of the early 1990s.
recession.zh: 20 世纪 90 年代初的经济衰退期间,数千家公司倒闭。

boom.en: The oil boom brought great wealth to the region in the 1970s.
boom.zh: 20 世纪 70 年代的石油繁荣给该地区带来了巨大财富。

growth.en: Economic growth in the region has slowed over the past two years.
growth.zh: 过去两年,该地区的经济增长放缓了。

gdp.en: Tourism accounts for about ten percent of the country's GDP.
gdp.zh: 旅游业约占该国国内生产总值的百分之十。

prosperity.en: The new railway brought prosperity to towns along the coast.
prosperity.zh: 新铁路给沿海城镇带来了繁荣。

poverty.en: Education is one of the most effective ways of reducing poverty.
poverty.zh: 教育是减少贫穷最有效的方法之一。

wealth.en: The town's wealth came mainly from trade in wool and cloth.
wealth.zh: 这个城镇的财富主要来自羊毛和布匹贸易。

affluent.en: People in affluent countries tend to throw away large amounts of food.
affluent.zh: 富裕国家的人往往扔掉大量食物。

tax.en: A higher tax on fuel could encourage people to drive less.
tax.zh: 提高燃油税可以鼓励人们少开车。

tax.en: The government decided to tax sugary drinks in order to improve public health.
tax.zh: 政府决定对含糖饮料征税,以改善公众健康。

taxation.en: Progressive taxation means that people with higher incomes pay a larger share.
taxation.zh: 累进税收意味着收入较高的人缴纳更大比例的税。

subsidy.en: A government subsidy keeps the price of bread low in many countries.
subsidy.zh: 在许多国家,政府补贴使面包价格保持在低水平。

tariff.en: A high tariff on imported steel protected local producers from competition.
tariff.zh: 进口钢材的高关税保护了本地生产商免受竞争。

trade.en: Trade between the two regions grew rapidly after the road was built.
trade.zh: 道路修通后,两个地区之间的贸易迅速增长。

import.en: Imports of cheap clothing have damaged the local textile industry.
import.zh: 廉价服装的进口损害了当地纺织业。

import.en: The country has to import most of its food and energy.
import.zh: 这个国家的大部分食物和能源都要进口。

export.en: Coffee is still the country's most important export today.
export.zh: 咖啡至今仍是该国最重要的出口产品。

export.en: China began to export silk to Europe more than two thousand years ago.
export.zh: 中国两千多年前就开始向欧洲出口丝绸。

commodity.en: Oil is the world's most heavily traded commodity.
commodity.zh: 石油是世界上交易量最大的商品。

goods.en: The canal allowed goods to be moved much more cheaply than by road.
goods.zh: 运河使货物运输比公路便宜得多。

service.en: The banking service has moved almost entirely online in recent years.
service.zh: 近年来,银行服务几乎完全转到了线上。

supply.en: A reliable water supply is essential for the growth of any city.
supply.zh: 可靠的供水对任何城市的发展都至关重要。

supply.en: Local farmers supply most of the vegetables sold in the town's markets.
supply.zh: 当地农民供应镇上市场出售的大部分蔬菜。

market.en: The market for electric cars has grown rapidly in recent years.
market.zh: 近年来,电动汽车市场迅速增长。

monopoly.en: For many years, the state had a monopoly on the sale of salt.
monopoly.zh: 多年来,国家垄断了盐的销售。

competitor.en: The company's main competitor has just lowered its prices.
competitor.zh: 公司的主要竞争者刚刚降低了价格。

competitive.en: Lower wages have helped to make the country's exports more competitive.
competitive.zh: 较低的工资帮助该国的出口产品更具竞争力。

consumer.en: Consumers are increasingly choosing products that do not harm the environment.
consumer.zh: 消费者越来越多地选择不损害环境的产品。

consumption.en: Meat consumption has risen rapidly as incomes have increased.
consumption.zh: 随着收入增加,肉类消费迅速增长。

producer.en: The country is the world's largest producer of coffee.
producer.zh: 这个国家是世界上最大的咖啡生产国。

manufacture.en: The factory began to manufacture bicycles at the end of the war.
manufacture.zh: 这家工厂在战争结束时开始制造自行车。

manufacturer.en: The manufacturer has recalled thousands of cars because of a brake problem.
manufacturer.zh: 由于刹车问题,制造商召回了数千辆汽车。

industry.en: The car industry employs thousands of people in the north of the country.
industry.zh: 汽车行业在该国北部雇用了数千人。

sector.en: The service sector now provides most of the jobs in large cities.
sector.zh: 现在大城市的大部分就业机会来自服务业。

enterprise.en: State-owned enterprises still control much of the country's energy supply.
enterprise.zh: 国有企业仍然控制着该国大部分能源供应。

corporation.en: The corporation has offices in more than forty countries.
corporation.zh: 这家公司在四十多个国家设有办事处。

multinational.en: Multinational companies can move production to wherever costs are lowest.
multinational.zh: 跨国公司可以把生产转移到成本最低的地方。

firm.en: The firm employs more than two thousand people across Europe.
firm.zh: 这家公司在欧洲各地雇用了两千多人。

firm.en: The government has taken a firm stand against illegal fishing.
firm.zh: 政府对非法捕鱼采取了坚定的立场。

start-up.en: The start-up received funding from investors to develop its new app.
start-up.zh: 这家初创公司获得了投资者的资金,用于开发新应用。

entrepreneur.en: The young entrepreneur built a successful business from a small market stall.
entrepreneur.zh: 这位年轻的企业家从一个小摊位起步,建立了成功的企业。

shareholder.en: Every shareholder has the right to vote at the annual meeting.
shareholder.zh: 每位股东都有权在年会上投票。

stock.en: The price of the company's stock fell sharply after the report.
stock.zh: 报告发表后,该公司的股票价格急剧下跌。

stock.en: Supermarkets now keep very little stock in their own warehouses.
stock.zh: 现在超市自己的仓库里库存很少。

share.en: The company has been losing its share of the European market.
share.zh: 这家公司在欧洲市场的份额一直在下降。

share.en: Scientists around the world share their data to speed up research.
share.zh: 世界各地的科学家分享数据,以加快研究。

dividend.en: Shareholders received a higher dividend after a very profitable year.
dividend.zh: 在利润丰厚的一年之后,股东们获得了更高的股息。

bankrupt.en: Several small airlines went bankrupt when the price of fuel rose.
bankrupt.zh: 燃油价格上涨后,几家小型航空公司破产了。

bankruptcy.en: Falling sales forced the company into bankruptcy after fifty years in business.
bankruptcy.zh: 销量下滑迫使这家经营了五十年的公司破产。

debt.en: Many students leave university with a large amount of debt.
debt.zh: 许多学生大学毕业时背负着大量债务。

interest.en: Banks charge higher interest on loans to small businesses.
interest.zh: 银行对小企业贷款收取更高的利息。

interest.en: Public interest in the subject has grown in recent years.
interest.zh: 近年来,公众对这个问题的兴趣有所增长。

advertising.en: Children are especially easily influenced by television advertising.
advertising.zh: 儿童尤其容易受到电视广告的影响。

advertisement.en: The first newspaper advertisement for the product appeared in 1890.
advertisement.zh: 这种产品的第一则报纸广告于 1890 年出现。

marketing.en: Successful marketing depends on understanding what customers really want.
marketing.zh: 成功的市场营销取决于了解顾客真正想要什么。

brand.en: People often pay more for a product with a well-known brand.
brand.zh: 人们常常愿意为知名品牌的产品付更多的钱。

logo.en: A simple logo helps customers to recognise a company's products.
logo.zh: 简单的标志有助于顾客识别公司的产品。

slogan.en: The company's slogan was soon known by people across the country.
slogan.zh: 这家公司的口号很快就为全国人民所知。

sales.en: Sales of printed books have fallen with the growth of digital reading.
sales.zh: 随着数字阅读的发展,纸质书的销售额下降了。

client.en: The bank gave each client advice on how to invest their savings.
client.zh: 银行就如何投资积蓄为每位客户提供建议。

merger.en: The merger of the two banks created one of the largest in Asia.
merger.zh: 两家银行合并后组成了亚洲最大的银行之一。

outsource.en: Many companies outsource production to countries where labour is cheaper.
outsource.zh: 许多公司把生产外包给劳动力更便宜的国家。

productivity.en: New technology has greatly increased productivity in the farming sector.
productivity.zh: 新技术大大提高了农业部门的生产率。

efficiency.en: The new engines have improved fuel efficiency by almost a third.
efficiency.zh: 新发动机把燃油效率提高了近三分之一。

labour.en: The shortage of cheap labour forced farmers to buy machines.
labour.zh: 廉价劳动力的短缺迫使农民购买机器。

workforce.en: Automation has reduced the size of the workforce in many manufacturing industries.
workforce.zh: 自动化缩减了许多制造行业的劳动力规模。

unemployment.en: Unemployment rose sharply when the local coal mines closed.
unemployment.zh: 当地煤矿关闭后,失业率急剧上升。

e-commerce.en: The growth of e-commerce has led to the closure of many high street shops.
e-commerce.zh: 电子商务的发展导致许多商业街店铺关闭。

deficit.en: The government plans to reduce its budget deficit by cutting spending.
deficit.zh: 政府计划通过削减开支来减少预算赤字。

levy.en: The new levy on plastic bags has greatly reduced their use.
levy.zh: 新的塑料袋税大大减少了它们的使用。

levy.en: The king tried to levy a new tax to pay for the war.
levy.zh: 国王试图征收一种新税来支付战争费用。

quota.en: Fishing boats must not catch more than their annual quota of cod.
quota.zh: 渔船捕捞的鳕鱼不得超过年度配额。

ration.en: The weekly ration of meat was very small during the war.
ration.zh: 战争期间,每周的肉类配给量很少。

ration.en: The government had to ration food for several years after the war.
ration.zh: 战后几年,政府不得不定量供应食品。

disburse.en: The fund will disburse money to farmers affected by the floods.
disburse.zh: 这个基金将向受洪灾影响的农民拨款。

fortune.en: He made a fortune from the sale of cotton in the 1850s.
fortune.zh: 他在 19 世纪 50 年代靠卖棉花发了财。

compensation.en: Families whose homes were destroyed received compensation from the government.
compensation.zh: 房屋被毁的家庭获得了政府的补偿。

depreciate.en: New cars begin to depreciate as soon as they leave the factory.
depreciate.zh: 新车一出厂就开始贬值。

patronage.en: Wealthy families provided patronage for artists during the Renaissance.
patronage.zh: 文艺复兴时期,富裕家族赞助了艺术家。

endowment.en: The university's large endowment pays for scholarships and new research.
endowment.zh: 这所大学的巨额捐赠基金用于支付奖学金和新研究。

prosperous.en: The town became prosperous through its trade in wool.
prosperous.zh: 这座城镇通过羊毛贸易变得繁荣起来。

profitable.en: The new product line has proved highly profitable for the company.
profitable.zh: 事实证明,新产品线为公司带来了丰厚的利润。

sweatshop.en: Workers in the sweatshop sewed clothes for very low wages.
sweatshop.zh: 血汗工厂的工人以极低的工资缝制衣服。

merchant.en: A wealthy merchant paid for the construction of the town's first hospital.
merchant.zh: 一位富商出资修建了镇上第一家医院。

purchasing-power.en: Rising prices have reduced the purchasing power of ordinary families.
purchasing-power.zh: 物价上涨降低了普通家庭的购买力。

joint-venture.en: The two companies formed a joint venture to build the new power station.
joint-venture.zh: 这两家公司成立了一家合资企业来建造新发电站。

intellectual-property.en: Stronger laws are needed to protect intellectual property on the internet.
intellectual-property.zh: 需要更严格的法律来保护互联网上的知识产权。

market-research.en: Market research showed that young people preferred the cheaper model.
market-research.zh: 市场调研显示年轻人更喜欢较便宜的型号。

advertising-campaign.en: The advertising campaign increased sales by more than twenty percent.
advertising-campaign.zh: 这次广告宣传活动使销售额增长了百分之二十多。

monetary.en: The central bank controls the country's monetary policy.
monetary.zh: 中央银行控制着国家的货币政策。

barrel.en: The price of oil rose above one hundred dollars a barrel.
barrel.zh: 石油价格涨到了每桶一百多美元。

gross.en: The gross income of the company reached ten million dollars last year.
gross.zh: 这家公司去年的总收入达到一千万美元。

auction.en: The painting was sold at auction for over a million pounds.
auction.zh: 这幅画在拍卖会上以一百多万英镑售出。

auction.en: The government decided to auction the rights to use the radio frequencies.
auction.zh: 政府决定拍卖无线电频率的使用权。

surplus.en: Countries with a food surplus can sell the extra to their neighbours.
surplus.zh: 粮食过剩的国家可以把多余的卖给邻国。

overhead.en: Lower overheads allow online shops to sell goods at cheaper prices.
overhead.zh: 较低的经常性开支让网店能以更便宜的价格销售商品。

overhead.en: Overhead power lines are being replaced by underground cables.
overhead.zh: 头顶上的电线正在被地下电缆取代。

nominal.en: Visitors pay only a nominal charge to enter the small museum.
nominal.zh: 参观这座小博物馆只需支付象征性的费用。

venture.en: Her first business venture failed, but she learned a great deal from it.
venture.zh: 她第一次创业失败了,但从中学到了很多。

equity.en: The bank agreed to provide equity for the new company.
equity.zh: 银行同意为这家新公司提供股本。

equity.en: The aim of the policy is to bring greater equity in health care.
equity.zh: 这项政策的目标是在医疗保健方面实现更大的公平。

stake.en: The government still holds a large stake in the national airline.
stake.zh: 政府仍持有这家国家航空公司的大量股份。

tender.en: Companies were invited to submit a tender for building the new bridge.
tender.zh: 公司受邀就建造新桥提交投标。

affiliate.en: The local radio station is an affiliate of a national network.
affiliate.zh: 这家地方电台是一家全国性广播网的附属机构。

lucrative.en: The trade in spices was extremely lucrative for European merchants.
lucrative.zh: 香料贸易对欧洲商人来说利润极高。

warehouse.en: The goods are stored in a large warehouse beside the motorway.
warehouse.zh: 这些货物存放在高速公路旁的一个大仓库里。

textile.en: The textile industry brought great wealth to northern England.
textile.zh: 纺织业给英格兰北部带来了巨大财富。

embargo.en: The oil embargo of 1973 caused prices to rise dramatically.
embargo.zh: 1973 年的石油禁运导致油价急剧上涨。

technology.en: New technology has changed the way that people work and study.
technology.zh: 新技术改变了人们的工作和学习方式。

technological.en: Rapid technological change has made many traditional jobs disappear.
technological.zh: 快速的技术变革使许多传统工作消失了。

innovation.en: Innovation is essential if small companies are to survive.
innovation.zh: 小公司要想生存,创新至关重要。

innovative.en: The company is known for its innovative approach to reducing waste.
innovative.zh: 这家公司以创新的减废方法闻名。

breakthrough.en: The discovery of penicillin was a major breakthrough in the treatment of infection.
breakthrough.zh: 青霉素的发现是治疗感染方面的重大突破。

cutting-edge.en: The laboratory uses cutting-edge equipment to study the structure of cells.
cutting-edge.zh: 实验室使用尖端设备研究细胞结构。

state-of-the-art.en: The new hospital has state-of-the-art equipment for treating heart disease.
state-of-the-art.zh: 新医院拥有治疗心脏病的最先进设备。

artificial-intelligence.en: Artificial intelligence is now being used to help doctors identify diseases.
artificial-intelligence.zh: 人工智能现在被用来帮助医生识别疾病。

algorithm.en: The algorithm learns to recognise faces from millions of photographs.
algorithm.zh: 这种算法从数百万张照片中学习识别人脸。

automation.en: Automation may replace many routine jobs in the coming decades.
automation.zh: 未来几十年,自动化可能取代许多重复性工作。

robot.en: A robot can now perform some kinds of surgery with great accuracy.
robot.zh: 现在机器人能高度精确地完成某些类型的手术。

robotics.en: Advances in robotics have transformed the way cars are built.
robotics.zh: 机器人学的进步改变了汽车的制造方式。

digital.en: Digital technology has made it easy to store and share photographs.
digital.zh: 数字技术让存储和分享照片变得很容易。

software.en: The new software can translate speech into text almost immediately.
software.zh: 新软件几乎能立刻把语音转成文字。

hardware.en: Older computer hardware cannot run the latest versions of the program.
hardware.zh: 旧的计算机硬件无法运行最新版本的程序。

processor.en: A faster processor allows the phone to run several programs at once.
processor.zh: 更快的处理器让手机能同时运行多个程序。

chip.en: The tiny chip contains billions of electronic parts.
chip.zh: 这块小芯片包含数十亿个电子元件。

network.en: The company has built a network of charging points across the country.
network.zh: 这家公司在全国建立了充电站网络。

online.en: More than half of all purchases in the country are now made online.
online.zh: 该国现在有一半以上的购买是在网上进行的。

browser.en: Each browser stores information about the websites that users visit.
browser.zh: 每个浏览器都会存储用户访问网站的信息。

server.en: Information is stored on a server that may be far from the user.
server.zh: 信息存储在可能离用户很远的服务器上。

cyberspace.en: Governments find it hard to enforce their laws in cyberspace.
cyberspace.zh: 政府发现很难在网络空间执法。

cybercrime.en: Cybercrime costs businesses billions of pounds in lost money each year.
cybercrime.zh: 网络犯罪每年使企业损失数十亿英镑。

hacker.en: A hacker stole the personal details of thousands of customers.
hacker.zh: 一名黑客窃取了数千名客户的个人信息。

privacy.en: Many people worry about their privacy when they use social media.
privacy.zh: 许多人使用社交媒体时担心隐私问题。

security.en: Banks have spent large sums on improving the security of online payments.
security.zh: 银行投入大量资金提高在线支付的安全。

encryption.en: Encryption protects messages from being read by anyone except the receiver.
encryption.zh: 加密保护信息不被接收者以外的任何人读取。

big-data.en: Companies use big data to predict what their customers will buy next.
big-data.zh: 公司利用大数据预测顾客接下来会买什么。

cloud-computing.en: Cloud computing allows small firms to store data at a low cost.
cloud-computing.zh: 云计算让小公司能以低成本存储数据。

virtual-reality.en: Medical students can practise operations safely using virtual reality.
virtual-reality.zh: 医学生可以利用虚拟现实安全地练习手术。

smartphone.en: The smartphone has changed the way people find information and communicate.
smartphone.zh: 智能手机改变了人们获取信息和交流的方式。

gadget.en: This small gadget measures how many steps you take each day.
gadget.zh: 这个小装置记录你每天走了多少步。

app.en: A new app helps patients to remember when to take their medicine.
app.zh: 一款新应用程序帮助患者记住服药时间。

interface.en: The simple interface of the program makes it easy for older people to use.
interface.zh: 这个程序简单的界面让老年人也能轻松使用。

user-friendly.en: The designers have tried to make the system more user-friendly.
user-friendly.zh: 设计者努力让这个系统更便于用户使用。

compatible.en: The new software is not compatible with older types of computer.
compatible.zh: 新软件与旧型号的计算机不兼容。

upgrade.en: The city plans to upgrade its old water pipes over the next ten years.
upgrade.zh: 这座城市计划在未来十年升级老旧水管。

obsolete.en: Many skills have become obsolete because of developments in technology.
obsolete.zh: 由于技术发展,许多技能已被淘汰。

outdated.en: Much of the country's railway system is now outdated and slow.
outdated.zh: 该国大部分铁路系统现在已经过时,而且速度缓慢。

telecommunication.en: Telecommunication satellites allow people to make calls from remote areas.
telecommunication.zh: 电信卫星让人们能在偏远地区打电话。

broadband.en: Fast broadband is still unavailable in many remote rural villages.
broadband.zh: 许多偏远农村仍然用不上高速宽带。

wireless.en: Wireless technology allows farmers to monitor their fields from their phones.
wireless.zh: 无线技术让农民能用手机监控农田。

signal.en: The satellite sends a signal back to Earth every few minutes.
signal.zh: 这颗卫星每隔几分钟向地球发回一次信号。

sensor.en: A sensor in the soil tells the farmer when the plants need water.
sensor.zh: 土壤中的传感器告诉农民植物何时需要浇水。

3d-printing.en: 3D printing allows engineers to produce complex parts at a low cost.
3d-printing.zh: 3D 打印让工程师能以低成本制造复杂的零件。

nanotechnology.en: Nanotechnology may one day allow doctors to deliver drugs directly to cells.
nanotechnology.zh: 有朝一日,纳米技术可能让医生把药物直接送到细胞。

biotechnology.en: Advances in biotechnology have produced crops that can resist disease.
biotechnology.zh: 生物技术的进步培育出了能抵抗疾病的作物。

genetic-engineering.en: Genetic engineering could be used to make crops more resistant to drought.
genetic-engineering.zh: 基因工程可用于增强作物的抗旱能力。

cloning.en: The cloning of a sheep in 1996 caused great public debate.
cloning.zh: 1996 年克隆羊引发了公众的激烈争论。

virtual.en: Students can now take a virtual tour of the museum on the internet.
virtual.zh: 学生现在可以在网上虚拟参观博物馆。

automatic.en: Automatic doors allow people to enter the building without using their hands.
automatic.zh: 自动门让人们不用手就能进入大楼。

electronic.en: Electronic books have become popular, but printed books are still selling well.
electronic.zh: 电子书已经流行起来,但纸质书依然卖得很好。

transmission.en: Rapid transmission of the virus occurs in crowded places.
transmission.zh: 这种病毒在拥挤的地方传播迅速。

loop.en: A feedback loop can make global warming happen more quickly.
loop.zh: 反馈循环可能使全球变暖加快。

protocol.en: Every doctor must follow a strict safety protocol when handling the virus.
protocol.zh: 每位医生处理这种病毒时都必须遵守严格的安全规程。

transmit.en: Mosquitoes can transmit the disease from one person to another.
transmit.zh: 蚊子能把这种疾病从一个人传给另一个人。

configuration.en: The configuration of the seats can be changed for different events.
configuration.zh: 座位的配置可以根据不同活动调整。

node.en: Each node in the network passes information on to the next.
node.zh: 网络中的每个节点把信息传递给下一个节点。

binary.en: Computers store all their information in binary code using ones and zeros.
binary.zh: 计算机用由一和零组成的二进制代码存储所有信息。

erase.en: It is almost impossible to erase information completely from the internet.
erase.zh: 几乎不可能从互联网上彻底删除信息。

audio.en: The museum provides audio guides in more than twenty languages.
audio.zh: 博物馆提供二十多种语言的音频导览。

embed.en: Scientists hope to embed tiny sensors in the walls of new buildings.
embed.zh: 科学家希望把微型传感器嵌入新建筑的墙壁。

web.en: The growth of the web has changed how scientists share their research.
web.zh: 互联网的发展改变了科学家分享研究成果的方式。

mobile.en: Mobile phones have made banking possible in many remote areas.
mobile.zh: 手机让许多偏远地区也能使用银行服务。

storage.en: Cheap storage of electricity remains the main challenge for solar power.
storage.zh: 廉价储电仍是太阳能面临的主要挑战。

delete.en: Users can delete their personal data from the website at any time.
delete.zh: 用户可以随时从网站上删除个人数据。
